Member basis

Members are total members active during the month, from the client member counts table, using the last month of the selected range. A client with no row for that month counts as zero. Employees (EE) are the subscribers in the same counts. Call rate is calls ÷ members. Call-to-case rate is new cases ÷ calls. Case-to-consult rate is consults ÷ new cases. Consult-to-procedure rate is procedures ÷ consults. Each client counts toward every value it has.

Each client counts toward every value it has. A client with more than one carve-out appears under each one. Clients with no value for an attribute are left out of that ranking. Rates use the selected date range; the minimum case count keeps small groups from topping the rates. Counts only, no member-level data.
